title: BAD_JUPITER.PRODUCT
heading: Bad Jupiter
description: Designed chatbot and web-app onboarding, flows, and interfaces, taking user research into interactive prototypes and supporting a Product Hunt launch.

blocks.heading: From research to onboarding
blocks.body: I researched users and developed personas, then produced onboarding flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity mockups for Bad Jupiter’s chatbot and web application. I used Figma and Framer to prototype the interactions and supported the Product Hunt launch.
